besluite.fout: 'kon soms van die kalwers hou' reads first as the separable verb 'hou van' (could like the calves), so a Grade 5 reader stumbles.
besluite.rede: 'vir hulself hou' makes it plainly 'keep some of the calves' with the same people, qualifier 'soms' and meaning, and adds no fact.
'so baie hande' is natural plain Afrikaans and deliberately echoes the lesson title 'Baie hande maak ligte werk', so 'soveel' is a lateral move that loses the echo.
